title: Existence of glued prescribed section
statement: Let Y be a reduced scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-reduced-scheme] with a finite family of closed immersions i a : Z a → Y [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose underlying images cover Y. Assume each intersection of distinct images is discrete. Let M a be an invertible module on Z a [def-sc-invertible-module]. Let s a be a global section of M a, nonvanishing [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] at every point of each intersection involving a. There are an invertible N on Y, a global section t of N, and isomorphisms tensorPullback (i a) N ≅ M a [def-pc-module-pullback] taking the restriction of t (the unit of the canonical tensor-pullback adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]) to s a for every a.

proof.text: Obtain the open cover, unit cocycle g, component frames m, and local coefficient functions f from exists_component_section_cech_data. Apply exists_invertible_of_cech_transition to obtain an invertible N and free frames e with the same transition units.

The local sections f_b e_b agree on overlaps: restrict the scalar multiplication, substitute e_b=g_bc e_c, associate the scalars, and use f_b g_bc=f_c. Apply Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' to the underlying additive sheaf of N to obtain t with t|U_b=f_b e_b.

For each component pull back the frames e using the usual module-pullback adjunction. WeilConjectures IsFreeGenerator.pullback_unit_app makes them free generators. Unit naturality and linearity transfer their transition equations. The private matching_frame_relations helper turns matching frame transitions into matching scalar relations on every subopen. The private exists_iso_preserving_frame_relations helper constructs inverse morphisms with the existing glueHom construction; IsGlueValue uniqueness proves the inverse identities and keeps the local coefficient formula. This yields an isomorphism from the usual pullback of N to M_a carrying all local multiples of the pulled-back frames to the same multiples of m_ab.

Compare tensorPullback with usual pullback by left-adjoint uniqueness. Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identifies their units. On each preimage of U_b, the frame-preserving component isomorphism sends the pulled-back t to i_a^sharp(f_b)m_ab=s_a. Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' proves equality on global sections. Compose the two isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem existsGluedSection
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι]
    (Z : ι → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ a : ι, Z a ⟶ Y) [∀ a : ι, IsClosedImmersion (i a)]
    (hcover : (⋃ a : ι, Set.range (i a)) = Set.univ)
    (hdiscrete : ∀ a b : ι, a ≠ b →
      DiscreteTopology ↥(Set.range (i a) ∩ Set.range (i b)))
    (M : ∀ a : ι, (Z a).Modules) [∀ a : ι, (M a).IsInvertible]
    (s : ∀ a : ι, Γ(M a, ⊤))
    (hs : ∀ a b : ι, a ≠ b → Set.range (i a) ∩ Set.range (i b) ⊆
      i a '' nonvanishingLocus (M a) (s a)) :
    let res : ∀ (N : Y.Modules) (a : ι), Γ(N, ⊤) → Γ((tensorPullback (i a)).obj N, ⊤) :=
      fun N a t ↦ ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (i a))).unit.app N).val.app
        (op ⊤) t
    ∃ (N : Y.Modules) (t : Γ(N, ⊤)), N.IsInvertible ∧
      ∀ a : ι, ∃ e : (tensorPullback (i a)).obj N ≅ M a,
        e.hom.val.app (op ⊤) (res N a t) = s a
